BYRDONIS_NEST.pages.INITIAL.valkyrieDesc:
You spot an enormous [jitter][red]Shambling Beast[/red][/jitter] chase off an injured [green][sine]Green Byrd[/sine][/green].

In the alcove the byrd fled from, a [gold]single unguarded egg[/gold] lies abandoned.

[jitter][blue]You feel an urge claw at the edges of your mind...[/blue][/jitter]
BYRDONIS_NEST.pages.TAKE.valkyrieDescrip:
You gently scoop up the egg and hold it close.

[sine][blue]This is normal. This is what you were meant to do. You shall bring it back to your nest.[/blue][/sine]
BYRDONIS_NEST.pages.EAT.valkyrieDescript:
You push past the [jitter][color=#ec9894]invasive thoughts[/color][/jitter], crack the egg open and gobble it up.

You feel your body fight back against this sacrilege with all that it can muster, but after gagging a few times, you swallow down your breakfast.
[blue]It weighs on your conscience like a stone.[/blue]
SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.valkyrieDes:
On the floor lies a copy of
“Top 3 Ways to Conquer the Spire”

The book is [red]encrusted with blood[/red]... Could it be yours...? When did you lose it?

You don't have room to carry it, but you can skim it now.
SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.NO_OPTIONS.valkyrie: It's unfortunate all this blood got on it. You may find another copy elsewhere. Bye, old book!
SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.READ_ENTIRE_BOOK.va:
Still as insightful as the first time! Some choice quotes remain fresh in your mind:
“Avoid big monsters.”
“Take every card.”
“Blocking is for cowards.”

Maybe this is how you can still win.
SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.READ_PASSAGE.valkyr:
You flip to a random page:
“Defense 101: Don't get hit!”

Not that you needed that refresher, but you're more self-assured in the strategy you employ.
SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.READ_THE_BACK.valky:
You flip the book over and read the summary:
[blue]“Critics and Cultists agree that sharp and pointy weapons are the best way to inflict damage!”[/blue]

You agree too.
THEVALKYRIE-MAN_EGG_TREE.pages.INITIAL.d:
After hours of trudging through insect territory, [sine]the deafening buzzing of wings abruptly stops[/sine]. As you regain your bearings, you feel a stillness in the air -- as if no life exists here safe for a mighty tree of unusual coloration. And yet...


[gold]He[/gold] is behind the tree.
Well, there is a [gold]man[/gold] here.

He offered you [sine]something[sine].
THEVALKYRIE-MAN_EGG_TREE.pages.INITIAL.o: (This doesn't seem to be addressed to you.)
THEVALKYRIE-MAN_EGG_TREE.pages.LEAVE.des: You don't have time for this. You might have been dealt a room, but you're busy having to slay the spire, too.
THEVALKYRIE-MAN_EGG_TREE.pages.YES.descr:
You received an [blue]Egg[/blue].

Well, there is not a man there.

You feel ready to move on.
THEVALKYRIE-MAN_EGG_TREE.pages.NO.descri:
Then he needn't be here.

Strange men hiding behind trees distributing things are no basis for a cohesive deck. You resume your climb.
